description.en: A picture runs under the whole film; every scene is a lower third over it.
description.vi: Một hình chạy dưới suốt phim; mỗi cảnh chỉ là một dải chữ đè lên.

script.guidance: The picture carries the film; the words name what is being seen. One short headline per scene and at most one line under it. Never describe the footage — say the thing the viewer would not know from looking.

draw.guidance: Footage runs under every scene, so draw NO ground of any kind and leave most of the frame empty. Everything you draw sits in one band across the lower third: a translucent dark panel with a soft blur behind the type, its edges soft, and the type white with a light shadow so it survives any picture under it. Nothing in the upper two thirds.
motion: The band wipes or slides in once at the start of the scene, from the edge it is anchored to, over about 0.45s, and stays.
The type inside it fades up a beat after the band arrives, as one block.
Nothing else moves: the footage under you is already moving, and a second motion on top reads as a mistake.
